content: Phetelu yi Yowani ku thwala kimvuka kya mbuta kya Bayuta
Tangwa bakala zonza, Phetelu yi Yowani, kwena batu, banganga Nzambi yi kaphita wa batsinzidi ba nzu ya Nzambi yi Basadise
bátula.
Básidika mu kubamona, bathumwa bawu bodi, mu kulonga kwena batu yi mu kubasamwana kikuma kya Yesu, lufutumuku lwandi ha kati dya bafwa, mu kusongila ni kilumbu kimosi batu bafútumuka.
Hanga babakwati, babakotisi phi mu boloku muna phipa meni yana yi kuna kilumbu kyalanda, mukuma kuma kwayila kwákala
Amana batu lawu hana kati dya bana bayuka malongi, hanga bakituki bakwikidi; amana thalu ya bayakala yátombuka bela-bela yi mafunda ma tanu.
Amana kilumbu kyalanda, bapfumu ba bawu yi bathwadisi ba nzu ya Nzambi yi balongi ba mitsiku bákutakana kuna Yelusalemi.
Hákala hika yi nganga Nzambi wa mbuta Ana yi Khayifu yi Yowani
yi Lekizandi yi boosu bana bákala mu kikanda kya bambuta ba banganga Nzambi.
Amana buna bábanata Phetelu yi Yowani ku thwala ya bawu, bábahyula phi bwabu: «Mu ngolu za nati yi mu khumbu ya nati wuluhangidi bwabuna?»
Hanga Phetelu, wabasa yi Kitembu Kyatoma, wubazimbwadi: «Balemba yi bathwadisi ba nzu ya Nzambi:
batufundisidi lelu kikuma kya dyambu dya mboti dimosi tusadi kwena mukwa khonzu yi buna kabelukidi.

Zayenubwoku mboti, benu boosu, yi bisi Kiseledi ni mu khumbu ya Yesu Kidisitu mwisi Nazaleti, wuna lwákhoka ha kitakani, amana Nzambi wámufutumuna ha kati dya bafwa, mwena yandi katelamini mutu yandu yi lutu lwa kitoku ku thwala ya benu.»
«Yandi:

content.text: "Yi tadi dina lwálosa benu batungi ba nzu,
amana dyákituka tadi dya sina dya mupfundila

content: «Luhulusu lweku mwena mutu wahika yuka ka mwena Yandi ku, mukuma mweku khumbu ya hika, mu sina dya zilu, yina bahana kwena batu yina tufwani twahulukila.»
Mu kumona kikumbwala kya Phetelu yi Yowani, báyituka lawu, mukuma bakala bazayila ni bawu batu bakonda longuka, bábakula phi ni babana bázinga yi Yesu.
Kaasi bwosu bakala mona, hana kabeta ka bawu, mutu wuna wábeluka, wutelamiki, bámonaku hika kima kya kuzonza.
Bábasenda batelama ha mbasi, amana báyandika kutendana bawu yi bawu,
yi kuzimbulaka: «Biki twabáhanga batu baba? Kikuma, batu boosu ba Yelusalemi bazayi ni kiphadi kyaki kya mbuta, mu nzila ya bawu kisalamini amana twalendakyoku mu kutuna.
Kaasi tubakandisenu ndangu dyambu dina diyalanganaku lawu ha kati dya batu, bazonziladyoku keti kwena mutu mosi mu khumbu yina.»
Amana bábatela, bábakandisa phi mu kuzonzila keti kulonga hika mu khumbu ya Yesu.
Kaasi Phetelu yi Yowani babavutwadi: «Bwalunga bwenina ku mesu ma Nzambi yukani twalemvukila benu hana tufwani kulemvukila Nzambi? Zengenu benu-benu.
Mukuma betu, tufwaniku kubusa kuzonzila mambu mana twámona yi mana twáyuka.»
Malemba bábayangisa hika kunima bábayambwadila, bámonaku phila ya kubahekila ndola; kikuma batu boosu Nzambi bakala zatula mu kumona mambu mana máluta.
Mukuma mutu wuna wábeluka mu kiphadi kina kákala yi mvula ziluti makumaya.
Lombilu lwa bakwikidi
Kunima dya kubasula, Phetelu yi Yowani benda menika kwena banduku ba bawu mambu mana moosu bábazimbwala kwena malemba yi banganga Nzambi.
Buna báyuka bwabuna, boosu báthuta ndinga mu kimosi, kwena Nzambi amana bázimbula: «Mulongi, ngeyi wáhanga tsi yi zilu yi mayanga yi bina byosu byenamwa.
Ngeyi wázonza, mu ngolu za Kitembu Kyatoma, mu munwa wa khaka wetu Tavidi musadi waku:

content.text: "Kikuma kya biki bibati vwalanganina bikanda byosu?
Amana kikuma kya biki batu bakasi mafwongu makonda kima?
kikuma kya kunwanisa Pfumu yi Kidisitu wandi."

content: Mukuma, mu kyedika, ni kikuma kya kunwanisa musadi waku watoma wuna wáyadika Yesu bakasidi fwongu Eloti yi Phosi Philatu mu mbanza yayi, kumosi yi makanda yi batu ba Kiseledi.
Kikuma kya kulungisa lwesi byosu bina wátekila zola mu ngolu zaku.
Amana buthwena, Pfumu, tala tsokisila za bawu amana hana ngolu kwena basadi baku mu kulonga malongi maku yi kikumbwala.
Lambula koku dyaku ndangu kubeluka kwakala, bidimbu bya khumbwa yi biphadi bya phila yi phila byamónika mu khumbu ya musadi waku watoma Yesu.»
Tangwa bálombila, homa hana bákala, háningana. Boosu bábasa yi Kitembu kyatoma, bakala longa phi ndinga ya Nzambi yi kikumbwala.
Bakwikidi babundikisi bima homa ha mosi
Kibuka kya batu bana bákwikila kyákala yi mbundu mosi yi moya mosi. Hákalaku mutu wakala zimbula ni bima byandi kikuma kya yandi buhika; kaasi kosu kima kyákala mu kimvuka.
Amana yi ngolu za lawu, bathumwa, bakala ta kimbangi kya lufutumuku lwa Pfumu Yesu; amana phi khenda za lawu zákala bawu boosu.
Amana ha kati dya bawu, ka mutu ku wákala yi mupfunu wa kima. Mukuma boosu bana bákala yi bilanga holo yi nzu, bakalabya tekisa, banati thalu yina bátekisila,
bazesibya muna malu ma bathumwa; amana bawu bakala kabisa kwena kosu mutu, bwosu bwákala mupfunu wandi.
Bwabuna Yozefu, wuna bakala tela Balanabasi kwena bathumwa, disongidila: «Mutu wisi hana kikesa», mulefi, mwisi Siphe,
wátekisa mafu mamosi mana kavwa, wánata makuta amana wásikulama muna malu ma bathumwa.

footnotes.text: Basadise: kibuka kimosi muna nzu ya Nzambi ya bayuta kina kyakala tala mambu ma nzu ya Nzambi yi nzu ya kisalu ya mbuta wa banganga Nzambi muna tangwa meni dina. Basadise bakalaku kwikila mwena banzyo, bakalaku kwikila phi ni Nzambi wufwani kuzingisa hika batu bafwa. Amana phi, bawu bakalaku kwikila mwena Masiya wuna wa mukyedika.

Mitsiku mya bayuta myákalaku hana muswa kwena bazusi ni bazenga mukanu mu phipha. Batwadisi ba nzu ya Nzambi báhana muswa kwena batsinzidi ndangu babasya mu boloku yi kuna kilumbu kyálanda. Bwabuna bwálunga kikuma kya bawu ku thwala ya kubafungwasa bathumwa bawu bodi.
Yowani yandi bazonzidi haka kena mosi hana kati dya batu bana bakala mu kikanda ya banganga-Nzambi. Keku mutu mosi yi Yowani wa thumwa.
Bayuta básadila lawu matadi mu kutunga nzu za bawu.
